content:
Renee: Proposal for the relaunch: run a "nurture velocity" experiment targeting dormant cohorts with a 3-touch micro-drip + intent routing. Two main experiments: subject personalization vs static, and coupon winback vs content-only. High-level plan below.

Tom: Love the experiments. Can you break down cadence and the canary plan? Also need legal sign-off for coupon in EU.

Renee: Cadence by dormancy bucket:
- 0-30d: single soft nudge at 48h
- 30-90d: 48h, 4d, 10d
- 90+d: immediate re-engage, final 7d, then suppress
Canary: 3% sample spread across IP pools (to avoid ISP fingerprinting), ramp to 25% in 6h, 60% in 18h, full send next day if metrics good. Region send windows: local time 10-14 (recipient tz).

Ivy: For personalization test: Subject A (static): "Quick update from Redwood Inference"; Subject B (personalized): "{{first_name}} — new benchmarks & a 1-min update". We'll A/B on opens. For winback: Variant X = 10% discount code (US only), Variant Y = content-only. EU: no discount by default until legal confirms.

legal-bot: EU rules: promotional coupons require explicit marketing consent for EU contacts. For any EU recipient, check consent_flag = true and consent_timestamp present. If missing, route to consent-first flow. Keep EU copy: privacy-first language.

Kris: Routing/intent: if user clicks AND product_page_views_7d >= 3 OR demo_request_form submits within 48h, create CRM lead with tag "nurture_intent_high" and send to sales webhook /integrations/sales/reengage. Include top_pages and last_7d_views in payload. Sales playbook = "nurture_speed_intro".

Tom: Deliverability plan: canary sample across all sending IPs, keep bounce threshold at 0.8% for canary. If complaint_rate > 0.05% or open rate below baseline -10%, pause ramp. Avoid sending more than 3 emails to same recipient in rolling 7d.

deliverability-bot: Last 30d metrics: hard_bounce=0.42%, soft_bounce=1.05%, complaint_rate=0.018%. Recommendation: suppress domains with >5 previous bounces, refresh suppression list, warm any new IPs for 7 days before heavy volume. Canary = 3% is conservative and good.

Renee: Tracking & UTM convention: utm_campaign=nurture_velocity_relaunch, utm_source=newsletter, utm_content=subjectA_subjectB|coupon|content + cta=benchmarks|tour. Example: ?utm_campaign=nurture_velocity_relaunch&utm_content=subjectB_coupon&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter&utm_term=cta_benchmarks

Ivy: Landing page split: /benchmarks-deepdive vs /product-tour-quick. We'll set cookies to prevent immediate re-show of re-engage across site. Also add event hooks for product_page_views_7d to update CRM flag in near real-time.

Renee: SQL to build cohorts (Ivy/Kris please validate):
```sql
SELECT id AS user_id, email, first_name, last_opened_at, region, product_page_views_7d, consent_flag, consent_timestamp
FROM newsletter_users
WHERE subscribed = true
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND (last_opened_at IS NULL OR last_opened_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days')
  AND email NOT IN (SELECT email FROM suppression_list)
```
Split into buckets: 0-30d, 30-90d, 90+. Export canary IDs to ESP staging list.

Kris: I'll add the demo_submission join and export the canary list. Also will implement the webhook and tag creation in CRM mapping.

Ivy: QA checklist: 1) canonical links resolve 2) UTM params attached 3) coupon codes validate server-side 4) ESP throttling configured 5) suppression list imported 6) inbox previews for Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo/AppleMail 7) EU consent gating for coupon recipients.

Tom: Timeline: canary Monday 9am PT (local windows applied), evaluate 24h, ramp Tue 9am PT, full Wed morning if green. Renee will approve final creative.

legal-bot: I'll review coupon copy and EU privacy blurb by EOD.

Renee: We'll also run a small creative micro-test: CTA A = "See benchmarks" (content funnel) vs CTA B = "Quick product tour" (activation funnel). Route clicks to different landing flows and measure MQL rate at 7 days.

Kris: Sales playbook note: include "how they engaged" line in the lead payload: clicked_cta, pages_viewed, last_opened_at. Keeps SDR context tight.

deliverability-bot: Final note: schedule canary across multiple hours to mimic normal traffic. Avoid large spikes from single IP at the start.

Ivy: I'll post subject + creative screenshots and the two landing page previews in this thread by EOD. Kris will share canary export. Tom will upload the ramp bakeoff plan.

Renee: Great. If legal signs coupon for non-EU, we'll include it in Variant X for US + APAC. Otherwise swap to content-only. Locking cadence and canary lists by EOD today. Thanks team 🚀
